speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are presenting with significant symptoms including fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, and weight loss, along with an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. To help narrow down the cause, I need to ask a few targeted questions. How long have these symptoms been present, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any painless swelling of the lymph nodes in other areas, such as your neck, armpits, or groin? Additionally, have you had any episodes of unexplained fever or noticed any itching of the skin?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of exposure to tuberculosis, recent travel to endemic areas, or any known immunocompromising conditions? I will also request a CT scan of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis to evaluate for internal lymphadenopathy or masses.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.
